'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[artillery]] [[shell (projectile)|shelling]] kills three [[International Committee of the Red Cross|Red Cross]] workers and injures two others in [[Donetsk Oblast]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/three-killed-two-injured-russian-shelling-eastern-ukrainian-village-2024-09-12/ (Reuters)]
**[[Foreign involvement in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***A spokesperson for the [[Ministry of External Affairs (India)|Indian Foreign Ministry]] say that about 45 [[Indian people|Indian]] nationals have been discharged from the Russian military, with efforts currently underway to get a further 50 Indians released. [https://www.reuters.com/world/russia-discharges-45-indians-fighting-its-army-2024-09-12/ (Reuters)]
**[[Kharkiv strikes (2022–present)|Kharkiv strikes]]
***[[Russia]]n shelling of the settlement of [[Borova, Izium Raion, Kharkiv Oblast|Borova]] in [[Kharkiv Oblast]], Ukraine, kills three [[civilian]]s and injures nine others, including several [[emergency service]] personnel. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-attack-village-ukraines-kharkiv-region-kills-three-injures-nine-2024-09-12/ (Reuters)]
**[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War]], [[Russia–NATO relations]]
***[[Russian president]] [[Vladimir Putin]] warns that Ukrainian use of [[NATO]] weapons to strike deep into Russian territory indicates NATO's formal entry into war against Russia, due to the programming of these weapons by NATO personnel representing a "direct confrontation". [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/ukraine-russia-putin-missiles-war-b2611904.html (''The Independent'')]
**[[Southern Ukraine campaign]]
***Ukraine accuses Russia of conducting [[missile]] strikes on a [[Saint Kitts and Nevis]]-flagged [[bulk carrier]] carrying grain to [[Egypt]] in the [[exclusive economic zone]] of [[Romania]] in the [[Black Sea]]. No casualties are reported. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-missile-hits-civilian-ship-with-ukrainian-grain-black-sea-zelenskiy-says-2024-09-12/ (Reuters)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[2024 Israeli military operation in the West Bank]]
***The death toll from [[Israel]]'s [[military operation]] in the [[Israeli occupation of the West Bank|occupied]] [[West Bank]] increases to 50, with three people killed by a [[Drone warfare|drone strike]] in [[Tulkarm]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/9/12/israels-war-on-gaza-live-women-children-blown-to-pieces-in-school-raid?update=3174049 (Al Jazeera)]

***The [[U.S. State Department]] approves $165 million in weapons sales to Israel to fund [[tank transporter]]s along with spare parts, tool kits, and technical and logistics support. The parts are expected to be delivered in 2027. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-weapons-us-tank-trailers-b5882a9ed12ad9d2ffe0a48a297f0424 (AP)]
*[[Afghanistan conflict (1978–present)|Afghan conflict]]
**[[2024 Afghanistan bus shooting]]
***Fourteen people are killed and six more are injured during a [[mass shooting]] by [[Islamic State  – Khorasan Province|Islamic State]] militants against a bus carrying [[Shia Islam in Afghanistan|Shia]] [[Hazaras|Hazara people]] between the [[Afghanistan|Afghan]] [[Provinces of Afghanistan|provinces]] of [[Ghor Province|Ghor]] and [[Daikundi Province|Daikundi]], after returning from a [[pilgrimage]] in [[Iraq]]. [https://apnews.com/article/afghanistan-islamic-state-shiite-hazara-attack-c6e6e4004a11569156723f9061a7f0dc (AP)]

**Three [[border guard]]s are killed and a civilian is injured by [[Jaish ul-Adl]] gunmen in [[Mirjaveh]], [[Sistan and Baluchestan province]], [[Iran]]. **[[Microsoft]] announces that it will [[layoff|lay off]] 650 [[Microsoft Gaming]] employees as part of cuts to its workforce. [https://variety.com/2024/gaming/news/microsoft-gaming-layoffs-650-employees-1236141947/ (''Variety'')]

'''Health and environment'''

'''International relations'''
*[[Jordan–United Kingdom relations]]
**The [[United Kingdom]] suspends [[Visa policy of the United Kingdom|visa-exempt status]] for [[Jordan]]ian nationals traveling to the UK due to an increase in [[asylum claim]]s made by [[Jordanians]]. [https://www.jpost.com/international/article-819891 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
*[[Peace negotiations in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]], [[Brazil–Ukraine relations]], [[China–Ukraine relations]]
**[[Ukrainian president]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] strongly denounces a [[Brazil]]ian–[[China|Chinese]] peace initiative, stating that both nations are effectively siding with [[Russia]] for allowing the [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian army]] to take [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] territory as a means to "[[De-escalation|de-escalate]]" [[Russo-Ukrainian War|the war]] instead of assisting Ukraine in resisting [[Russian invasion of Ukraine|the invasion]]. [https://kyivindependent.com/zelensky-on-china-brazil-plan/ (''Kyiv Independent'')]
